name: Kyubere
source:
Comes from: Somewhere near Mediterranean Sea

The most mature among the five goddesses, a big sister whose every action feels erotic. She often refers to Yutaka per "young man." As the big sister of Rhea's, she appears to be used to younger people. She has the greatest abilities among the five goddesses, being capable of manipulating both space and time. However, she usually uses those abilities of hers for making up perverted situations.
Despite the fact she looks very mature, she has an immature personality and is devoid of both knowledge of sex and common sense. Because she doesn't know "shame," she doesn't choose time or place when she's in the mood for sex. However, ever since she has come to the human world, she has grown to show a little shame.

It can't be said she's too serious about her work in the shrine, and together with Tiamat she often skips out. She then gets scolded by Rhea every time (though she isn't bothered by that.)
